title: BUG: tasks update without --status must not null the status (crashes tasks list)
desc: Repro on main: 'chatcode tasks update <id> --pr <url>' (or --note only, no --status) sets status to null. Consequences: (1) plain 'tasks list' crashes with TypeError in the print path (--json still works); (2) silent data loss on the board — two live tasks (2f3d, f0d2) were nulled by exactly this. Expected: an update that does not pass --status keeps the current status. Found by marcus-aurelius (alert #48610e9f, 19:14Z); records restored by scott.
